create_skill: create a new skill by posting a SkillForm to the skills create endpoint
get_skills: get all skills accessible to the current user with read permissions
get_skill_list: search and paginate skills with optional query and view option filters
update_skill_by_id: update an existing skill by id with new SkillForm data after write access check
delete_skill_by_id: delete a skill by id after verifying the user has write access or admin role
